surface_mechanism_description: The ALD reactions are surface limited. Gaseous precursors are dosed into the reaction chamber that reacts with the surface species. Reactions continue till all the surface species gets converted to a newer functionality. The unconsumed reactants and the reaction products are simultaneously pumped out from the reaction chamber. The rate limiting surface reaction thus ensures the layer-by-layer growth of the material.
